# Vendored libraries

Self-hosted so the site needs no third-party host. Fetched from the npm registry.

| File | Package | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `three.min.js` | three 0.128.0 | MIT, see `three.LICENSE` |
| `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | gsap 3.12.5 | GSAP's standard no-charge licence, https://gsap.com/standard-license |

The published artifact loads the same versions from cdnjs instead.
